2469.title: Terminal hyperlink targets can become inaccessible in bb
2469.rootCauseOneLine: The host omits the hyperlink capability variable, and the shared terminal omits a safe OSC 8 handler.

prReviews.topFinding: The outer React handler runs after xterm can replace the macOS selection. Eight mobile changes also target removed code.

2469.proposedFix: Set FORCE_HYPERLINK=1. Add a safe shared-app OSC 8 handler. Capture terminal.getSelection() before xterm handles the context-menu event.
2469.caveats: The live browser ran on Linux. The event check set the exact xterm macOS option. Cleanup removed all isolated processes, ports, data, and the worktree.

2450.title: Split right-panel panes have no close action when their only tab is fixed
2450.rootCauseOneLine: The split contract removes only empty panes, while fixed tabs cannot close and each fixed-tab pane lacks a direct remove action.

prReviews.topFinding: The PR adds a tab-preserving pane removal action, passes the base regression, and merges cleanly into the current base.

2450.proposedFix: Add a pane removal state action that moves every tab to the focused survivor. Show its button on each pane only during a split.
2450.caveats: The GitHub token lacked project-field scope, so the report uses the prompt priority and issue effort estimate. PR #2486 had one unrelated timed-out CI job. The exact base merge passed 52 focused tests and the app typecheck.

2449.title: Host-readable absolute --image paths render as broken thumbnails in project threads
2449.rootCauseOneLine: The server stores an absolute localImage path, but the project timeline sends it to an endpoint that accepts only stored attachments.
2449.proposedFix: Before prompt storage, read each absolute localImage from the selected host and store its bytes as a project attachment. Persist the returned relative path across spawn, tell, fork, deferred sends, and queued messages.
2449.caveats: The live test used one local execution host. It did not test a different machine. PR #2579 appeared after the workflow selected an empty PR set, so this report does not review it.

2400.title: thread spawn accepts a nonexistent model: rc=0, provisions a worktree, fails as an agent message
2400.rootCauseOneLine: Explicit models skip the server model catalog, while reasoning validation checks provider-wide values instead of the selected model.
2400.proposedFix: Add one target-aware server validator for model and reasoning tuples. Run it before thread creation and before Tasks preset persistence.
2400.caveats: Private usage counts and the automation path were not verified. PR #2581 appeared after scope and was not assigned for review. One private custom model identifier was redacted.

2394.title: Narrow side-chat composer collapses when opening the model picker
2394.rootCauseOneLine: The desktop popover blurs the side-chat editor before the picker opens, so the narrow composer hides the trigger before pointer release.
2394.proposedFix: Remove the premature desktop popover blur. Keep the compact mobile blur. Add a held-pointer test for the narrow composer.
2394.caveats: The revised reproduction passed from a clean browser page. The temporary fix passed 46 focused tests. The full app suite and iOS Safari require more checks.

2384.title: Conditionally selected plugin tool is not added when a released thread resumes
2384.rootCauseOneLine: Codex app-server ignores dynamicTools on thread/resume because its resume contract has no such field. Claude Code now works.
2384.proposedFix: Add dynamicTools support to Codex thread/resume and regenerate its types. If Codex cannot support this, start a history-preserving replacement session.
2384.caveats: The complete script reproduced the Codex fault and passed the Claude Code test. No open pull request was linked. The report includes sanitized wire evidence only.
